text:
Aisha: FYI — AcmePay escalated a model-behavior regression after last night's rollout. Their invoice-parsing prompt now returns truncated line-items (used to be complete). They say it started ~2026-03-16 23:40 UTC. Internal evals on same model + prompt pass. Can someone help triage? (request ids provided below)
Jordan: ack. can you paste the exact prompt + the failing response + a passing example from before? also need request ids, model name, and variant.
Aisha: prompt (redacted customer data):
```
System: You are an invoice parser. Extract line items as JSON array with fields: description, qty, unit_price, total.
User: Invoice:
... (customer invoice text) ...
```
observed (customer): `[{"description":"Widget A","qty":"1"}]` — only first line item returned, missing subsequent items.
expected (historic): `[{"description":"Widget A","qty":1,"unit_price":9.99,"total":9.99},{"description":"Consulting","qty":2,"unit_price":150.00,"total":300.00}]`
request IDs: `req_8c9f2a`, `req_8c9f2b` (timestamps match their report). Model: `redwood-parser-1.1` routing -> variant `quant-v2` (we rolled quant-v2 yesterday during canary).

Lee: :eyes: rollout note — can confirm `quant-v2` was promoted canary->prod 2026-03-16 22:30 UTC (deploy-bot: rollout 0.6->0.8). I'm checking runtime logs for those request ids now.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion: redwood-parser-1.1:quant-v2 promoted 2026-03-16T22:30:12Z by mira (canary=0.6->prod=0.8).

Sam: I just repro'd locally against prod model snapshot with customer's prompt (no PII). Quick notes: with `quant-v2` I see early termination at ~token 128, but non-quant baseline returns full list. Hypothesis: a decoding change or EOS behavior in the quantized kernel.

Jordan: interesting — our eval harness uses templated invoices which might not exercise the same line-break patterns the customer uses. can you run the customer's exact text through our eval harness (disable normalization) and compare logprobs/stop-token probabilities? maybe a tokenization edge.

Sam: running now. Command I'm using:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-parser-1.1","variant":"quant-v2","input":"<CUSTOMER_INVOICE_TEXT>","max_tokens":512,"stop":"\\n\\n"}'
```
Will paste output.

Mira: also please confirm the routing policy — product config allowed automatic fallback to `quant-v1` on high load? we need to know whether all the customer's requests hit quant-v2.

Lee: runtime logs for `req_8c9f2a`: 200 OK, latency 420ms, model served `redwood-parser-1.1:quant-v2`, kernel=kv-cache-optimized, decoder=greedy, tokens_out=64, truncated=true. Attached snippet from runtime (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T23:41:02Z] req=req_8c9f2a model=redwood-parser-1.1:quant-v2 tokens=0..64 truncated=true eos_seen=false
[...]
```
truncated=true + eos_seen=false suggests token limit or early termination due to internal max output token heuristic. But Sam's job says tokens_out=64 while expected ~200 tokens.

Sam: output I see locally (quant-v2): ends with partial last item and `}]` missing. logprobs show sudden drop after token 63 and decoder returns termination. When I run baseline (float) on same machine, decoder continues and completes all items.

Jordan: can we run a quick targeted eval: 50 customer-specific invoices (real structure variants), compare pass rate quant-v2 vs baseline. If quant-v2 fails consistently, that's our repro and we can roll back.

Aisha: customer is asking for ETA and mitigation. they want either rollback or a hotfix. They're on SLA and this is blocking payment extraction flows.

Mira: agree. product preference — if we can confirm regression tied to quant-v2 behavior, do immediate rollback to quant-v1 for that model and initiate postmortem. I'll own the rollback decision once eng confirms.

Lee: rolling back is low-friction if we flip routing policy for that model to prefer quant-v1. I'll prepare a config change. Need approval from eng-ml and product.

Jordan: do the eval now — Sam, can you run the 50-customer-invoice set across both variants and push results to the shared eval spreadsheet? use `--no-normalize --preserve-newlines` to match customer. If failure rate delta > 10% we rollback.

Sam: running. quick summary after 12/50: quant-v2 pass=58%, baseline pass=96%. logs attached in thread (snippet).

Aisha: sharing customer tone: "This worked before the update; we cannot parse invoices reliably. Please escalate." They threatened to switch to alternate provider if not fixed in 24h. :grimacing:

Lee: I'm ready to flip routing. Jordan/Mira confirm and I'll apply. I'll set a canary of 10%->100% over 10m with monitoring.

Jordan: confirmed. rollback to quant-v1 for `redwood-parser-1.1` only. Set alert: error_rate>5% or avg_tokens_out drop -> auto-revert.

Mira: I'll inform CS to tell the customer that we're reverting to previous variant as immediate mitigation and will follow up with root cause. Aisha, pls send the rollback ETA to customer (ETA ~10-15m once config is applied).

Aisha: will do. message to customer: "We're rolling back model variant for your workspace to restore previous behavior; expect changes to take effect within 15 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

Sam: finishing full eval run now. I'll upload CSV and add a minimal failing example for the eng-ml repro PR.

Jordan: next steps: 1) rollback (Lee) 2) full repro set + bisect quant changes (Sam/Jordan) 3) postmortem + regression test added to eval harness (Mira/Jordan) 4) follow-up note to customer (Aisha). Assigning owners in thread.

Lee: applying routing change now. flipping 0.8->0.2 quant-v2->quant-v1 for `redwood-parser-1.1`...

deploy-bot: Routing config updated: redwood-parser-1.1 preferred_variant=quant-v1 applied 2026-03-17T00:12:30Z by lee. canary 10%->100% (10m).

Lee: monitoring metrics — within 5 minutes, tokens_out median increased from 70 -> 190 for the tracked request IDs. error rate on that workspace dropped from 18%->2%.

Aisha: customer confirmed change restored behavior: "Looks good so far, thanks." They want a detailed RCA and timeline.

Mira: we'll run full bisect tomorrow and propose a fix: either tune kernel decode heuristics or adjust EOS handling in quant-v2. Also add customer's invoice samples to regression corpus.

Sam: uploaded results: quant-v2 fail=22/50, baseline fail=2/50. Added 6 minimal repro prompts. PR with repro + logs -> #repo/eng-ml/issue-542.

Jordan: thanks team. leaving notes: immediate mitigation done. action owners: Lee=rollback applied, Sam=bisect + repro, Jordan=eval harness changes, Mira=postmortem and customer comms, Aisha=customer follow-up. Closing thread after postmortem scheduled.
